// Package unformatted holds what gofmt would rewrite: parentheses around the condition and the ranged value, which the
// pattern looks through, and empty statements, which the parser keeps and the query counts.
package unformatted

func parenthesized(values []int) {
	if (values != nil) {
		for range values {
		}
	}
	if values != nil {
		for range (values) {
		}
	}
	if ((values) != nil) {
		for range ((values)) {
		}
	}
}

func emptyStatements(values []int) {
	// An empty statement before the range makes the body two statements.
	if values != nil {
		; for range values {
		}
	}
	// A semicolon after the range ends its statement and adds none.
	if values != nil {
		for range values {
		};
	}
	// An else holding an empty statement is no empty else.
	if values != nil {
		for range values {
		}
	} else { ; }
}
